changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[PredicateIntersect] as SELECT I.ID AS IntersectID, I.uid, I.IntersectTypeID, I.Subject, I.SubjectID, I.Object, I.ObjectID, I.State, T.PredicateID, P.Name AS PredicateName, P.Inverse AS PredicateInverse, P.Type AS PredicateType FROM dbo.[Intersect] AS I INNER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS T ON T.ID = I.IntersectTypeID LEFT JOIN dbo.Predicate AS P ON P.ID = T.PredicateID
